# Demo project

<a id="REQ-001"></a>
## 1. Greeting

The greeter MUST greet the user by name.

*Acceptance criteria:*

<a id="AC-001"></a>**Greets by name**

`greet.sh World` prints `Hello, World!`.

<a id="REQ-002"></a>
## 2. Farewell

The greeter SHOULD say goodbye when asked to.

*Acceptance criteria:*

<a id="AC-002"></a>**Says goodbye**

`greet.sh --bye World` prints `Goodbye, World!`.
